headline: 1Password lets AI agents sign into accounts without seeing passwords
summary: 1Password launched a feature letting AI agents log into a user's accounts and complete tasks like booking or buying, while keeping passwords hidden and still requiring user approval for sign-ins.

claims.statement: 1Password introduced a feature letting AI agents sign into accounts without the agent seeing the password.

sources.quote: 1Password lets AI agents use your passwords without seeing them
1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password

claims.statement: Users must still approve each AI agent sign-in request.

sources.quote: you'll still need to grant approval for sign-in requests

claims.statement: The feature is named 1Password for Agents.
The feature can let AI agents book or buy things on a user's behalf.

sources.quote: let AI book or buy things on your behalf

claims.statement: The feature protects account credentials while letting agents log in.

sources.quote: still protecting the private credentials that secure those accounts

discrepancies.explanation: Engadget's headline frames the feature as handing data security to AI agents, while Verge and TechCrunch frame it as keeping passwords hidden from those agents.

quotes.quote: hand your data security over to your preferred AI agent
use your passwords without seeing them
